verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an inference cloud, and a platform of this type could plausibly offer scheduled or background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no automation, scheduling, or autonomous background-job feature. The flex tier for "asynchronous workloads" is only a lower-cost, lower-priority request tier, and SSH GPU clusters are raw infrastructure a user would have to build on themselves. Neither counts as the product's own automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
